policy: Supplement the automated physical-minifigure corpus with authoritative external catalog evidence when a named nonstandard molded character is absent from candidate retrieval. Preserve source-time chronology: pre-source physical releases may be valid candidates, while later redesigns cannot be assumed source-equivalent without direct visual evidence.

automated_candidate_failure.observation: The top automated candidates are unrelated standard minifigures and omit both cataloged Salacious B. Crumb physical figures entirely.
automated_candidate_failure.likely_cause: The current physical candidate corpus/retriever does not reliably surface nonstandard single-mold creature/character figures that Brickset and BrickLink catalog as minifigures.

records.reason: Brickset and BrickLink independently catalog Salacious B. Crumb as sw0408 in 9516 Jabba's Palace from 2012, proving a named physical counterpart existed a decade before The Skywalker Saga. Brickset also catalogs a revised sw1387 version from 2024, which is too late to establish the 2022 source artwork. The correct outcome is therefore a verified physical character family with the 2012 release temporally eligible, not 'no physical release'; exact game-to-2012 eye/mold artwork equivalence remains visual-pending.
